```{r}
metadata.predict
```

```{r}
metadata.demo.score <- metadata.predict %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0" & participant_id %in% metadata.gex$participant_id & tissue != "BLD") %>% 
  distinct(participant_id, age, sex, race, ethnicity, score_type, severity_score, weighted_severity_score, severity_score_date, severity_score_range, weighted_score_range) %>% 
  mutate(weighted_score_range = ifelse(weighted_score_range == "NM",
                                       weighted_score_range, 
                                       str_to_title(weighted_score_range)))

metadata.demo.score
```

```{r}
# ensure correct age and gender from corrected spreadsheet
metadata.col.demo.score <- metadata.col %>% 
  select(-age, -gender, -score_type, -matches("severity")) %>% 
  left_join(metadata.demo.score, by = "participant_id") %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = contains("score"),
    .fn = ~ifelse(diagSub == "FGID", NA, .)
  )) %>% 
  mutate(weighted_score_range = ifelse(score_type == "PUCAI", NA, weighted_score_range))

metadata.col.demo.score
```


```{r}
clinical <- metadata.col.demo.score %>% 
  filter(!(participant_id %in% c("001-002", "001-004", "001-006", "001-010"))) %>% # remove samples without T0 GEX LP or EPI
  mutate(subgroup_primary = ifelse(participant_id == "001-019", "colonic", subgroup_primary)) %>% # LK said we'll classify as colonic
  mutate(subgroup_primary = ifelse(participant_id %in% c("003-034", "003-036"), "pancolitis", subgroup_primary)) %>% # manually set based on redcap data
  group_by(participant_id) %>% 
  mutate(age = min(age)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(months = days/(365/12)) %>% 
  mutate(months = ifelse(months != 0, label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())(months), NA)) %>% 
  mutate(months = ifelse(participant_id == "001-040", "12.197 + 24.164", months)) %>% # reconcile months manually
  mutate(across(.cols = c(score_type, severity_score_range), .fns = ~ifelse(. == "NM", NA, as.character(.)))) %>% 
  mutate(score_type = forcats::fct_relevel(score_type, c("PCDAI", "PUCAI"))) %>% 
  mutate(weighted_severity_score = ifelse(score_type == "PUCAI", NA, weighted_severity_score)) %>% 
  mutate(severity_score_range = ifelse(score_type == "PCDAI", weighted_score_range, severity_score_range)) %>% 
  mutate(severity_score_range = forcats::fct_relevel(severity_score_range, c("Remission", "Mild", "Moderate", "Severe"))) %>%
  mutate(antitnf_response = forcats::fct_relevel(antitnf_response, c("NM","NOA","FR","PR","NR"))) %>%
  mutate(data_type = case_when(
    data_type == "scGEX" ~ "GEX",
    data_type == "scVDJ" ~ "TCR"
  )) %>% 
  group_by(participant_id) %>% 
  fill(months, .direction = "updown") %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  select(participant_id, diagSub, subgroup_primary, antitnf_response, sex, race, ethnicity, age, months, site, timepoint, layer, score_type, severity_score, weighted_severity_score, severity_score_range, data_type) %>% 
  distinct(diagSub, subgroup_primary, antitnf_response, participant_id, timepoint, layer, data_type, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  arrange(participant_id, timepoint) %>% 
  relocate(participant_id, .after = antitnf_response)

clinical
```

```{r}
clinical.wide <- clinical %>% 
  mutate(biopsypresent = "X") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(timepoint, layer, data_type), values_from = biopsypresent, values_fill = NA) %>% 
  relocate(
    participant_id,
    diagSub:severity_score_range,
    T0_LP_GEX, T0_LP_TCR,
    T0_EPI_GEX, T0_EPI_TCR,
    R_LP_GEX, R_LP_TCR,
    R_EPI_GEX, R_EPI_TCR,
    R2_LP_GEX, R2_LP_TCR,
    R2_EPI_GEX, R2_EPI_TCR
  )

clinical.wide
```

```{r}
clinical.wide %>% 
  group_by(diagSub) %>% 
  summarise(median = signif(median(age),3), IQR = signif(IQR(age),3)) %>% 
  mutate(q25q75 = paste(
    signif(median-IQR/2,3), 
    signif(median+IQR/2,3), 
    sep = "-"))

```


```{r}
clinical.wide %>% 
  group_by(diagSub) %>% 
  summarise(
    median = signif(median(age),3), 
    q25 = signif(quantile(age,0.25),3),
    q75 = signif(quantile(age,0.75),3),
    ) %>% 
  mutate(IQR = paste(q25, q75,  sep = "-"), .after = median)

```

# UMIs

```{r}
colon_sites <- c("Right", "Right/Transverse", "Transverse", "Left/Transverse", "Left", "Left/Rectosigmoid", "Rectosigmoid", "Rectosigmoid/Rectum", "Rectum")
colon_values <- seq.int(0,1, length.out = length(colon_sites))
names(colon_values) <- colon_sites
colon_values
colon_values <- c("Not specified" = NA, colon_values)
```


```{r}
obs.orig <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs.orig

obs <- obs.orig %>% 
  select(-colon_site, -colon_value) %>% 
  left_join(metadata.predict %>% filter(data_type == "scGEX") %>%  select(sample, colon_site), by = "sample") %>% 
  mutate(colon_site = fct_relevel(colon_site, 
                                  c("Not specified", "Right", "Right/Transverse", "Left/Transverse", 
                                    "Transverse", "Left", "Left/Rectosigmoid", 
                                    "Rectosigmoid", "Rectosigmoid/Rectum", "Rectum"))) %>%
  mutate(colon_value = colon_values[as.character(colon_site)]) %>% 
  relocate(colon_value, .after = colon_site)

obs
```


```{r}
stats.sample <- obs %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, timepoint, sample, site, version_10x, colon_site, layer) %>% 
  summarise("Mean UMIs" = mean(nCount_RNA),
            "Mean Genes" = mean(nFeature_RNA)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  select(-participant_id, -timepoint) %>% 
  rename(Sample = sample, `Version 10x` = version_10x, `Study Site` = site, `Colon Location` = colon_site, `Tissue Layer` = layer)

stats.sample 
```

```{r}
stats.biopsy <- obs %>% 
  group_by(participant_id, timepoint, biopsy, site, version_10x, colon_site) %>% 
  summarise("Mean UMIs" = mean(nCount_RNA),
            "Mean Genes" = mean(nFeature_RNA)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  select(-participant_id, -timepoint) %>% 
  rename(Biopsy = biopsy, `Version 10x` = version_10x, `Study Site` = site, `Colon Location` = colon_site)

stats.biopsy 
```

```{r}
stats.cellstate <- obs %>% 
  group_by(celltype, cellsubtype, cellstate) %>% 
  summarise("Mean UMIs" = mean(nCount_RNA),
            "Mean Genes" = mean(nFeature_RNA)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  rename(`CellType` = celltype, `CellSubtype` = cellsubtype, `CellState` = cellstate) %>% 
  arrange(CellState)

stats.cellstate
```

# Deidentification

We received the following suggestion during preprint submission:

"Exact ages should be replaced with age ranges (5 years minimum), exact dates and photographs should be removed, sample and patient IDs should be consecutive numbers to prevent identification of patients."

```{r}
clinical.wide.filtered.reformatted
```

```{r}
clinical.wide.filtered.reformatted$Age %>% range
```

```{r}
clinical.wide.filtered.reformatted.agerange <- clinical.wide.filtered.reformatted %>% 
  mutate(Age = case_when(
    Age >= 6 & Age < 11 ~ "6-10",
    Age >= 11 & Age < 16 ~ "11-15",
    Age >= 16 ~ "16+",
  )) %>% 
  mutate(Age = fct_relevel(Age, c("6-10", "11-15", "16+")))

clinical.wide.filtered.reformatted.agerange %>% arrange(Age) %>% relocate(Age, .after = Race)
```

# Make List and Export

```{r}
part_samples.out.agerange <- list(
  "Key" = data.frame(),
  "Participants and Samples" = clinical.wide.filtered.reformatted.agerange,
  "Cell Annotations and UMAP" = obs.anno.umap,
  "Tfh UMAP" = obs.anno.umap.tfh,
  "UMIs by Biopsy" = stats.biopsy,
  "UMIs by Sample" = stats.sample,
  "UMIs by CellState" = stats.cellstate,
  "Annotation Frequencies" = annotation.freq.out,
  "CellType by Biopsy" = annotation.biopsy.celltype,
  "CellSubtype by Biopsy" = annotation.biopsy.cellsubtype,
  "CellState by Biopsy" = annotation.biopsy.cellstate,
  "CellType by Sample" = annotation.sample.celltype,
  "CellSubtype by Sample" = annotation.sample.cellsubtype,
  "CellState by Sample" = annotation.sample.cellstate
)

part_samples.out.agerange
```

```{r}
write_xlsx(part_samples.out.agerange, 
           path = "out/tables/Supplemental Table 1 - Participants and Samples.xlsx", 
           col_names = TRUE, 
           format_headers = TRUE, 
)
```
